title: Verify error helper does not distinguish transport failure vs no-match
note: QC2 S-001. Spec-locked copy either way; distinguish in future.
closure_note: Added 'no-match' AgentVerifyStatus; AgentPicker shows 'No matching agent for this command.' (scan reached daemon, no agent matched) vs 'Could not reach this agent.' (transport failure). Both hosts map ok=false to no-match, catch to error.

title: AgentPicker re-renders entire card grid on verifyStatus change
note: QC3 W-001. Negligible at 2-6 cards; React.memo if grid grows.
closure_note: Wrapped AgentCard in React.memo; stabilized onSelect via ref pattern in AgentPicker so verifyStatus changes no longer trigger card re-renders.

title: useVerifyAgent mutation lacks unmount cancellation
note: QC3 W-002. Local daemon scan <100ms; minimal risk.
closure_note: Added AbortController to useVerifyAgent with useEffect cleanup on unmount; stale scan results after unmount throw AbortError instead of settling.

title: Selection-sync useEffect fires on every node interaction (not just selection changes) — latent perf trap
note: QC3 W-001. Acceptable at author-scale; derive from onNodesChange in future.
closure_note: Selection sync now guards on selected entity id change only; pure position drag no longer triggers inspector rebind.
